title: Unit-compatible actual and quotient completion reflectors
statement: For any adic coefficient datum d of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and scheme S, the actual intrinsic complete-subcategory reflector pbcActualCompletion d S is naturally isomorphic to completedReductionTower S d followed by completedRlim S (d.completedRing S), and the natural isomorphism carries pbcActualCompletionUnit to d.completionUnit. No completeness of the input is assumed.

source.place: Tags 099M and 099N; existing private actualCompletion_quotient proof in Sheaf.Paper.PbcCompletedPullbackActual

proof.text: Reuse the existing private actualCompletion_quotient via a proof-only import all of Sheaf.Paper.PbcCompletedPullbackActual. Its proof transfers the Koszul reflector property to quotient completion using the unit-compatible comparison.

The actual intrinsic-complete-subcategory reflector has the same universal property. The unique comparison maps commuting with the units are mutually inverse, by uniqueness; the same uniqueness proves naturality.

proof_origin.place: Reuse the complete private actualCompletion_quotient proof through import all, without changing its owner.

lean.statement:
theorem integralRoosCompletionReflectorComparison
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) :
    ∃ e : pbcActualCompletion d S ≅
        completedReductionTower S d ⋙ completedRlim S (d.completedRing S),
      ∀ M, (pbcActualCompletionUnit d S).app M ≫ e.hom.app M = d.completionUnit S M
